scenarios.name: Retain a command in the expanded panel across tab switches

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
Shell is in the Modify main panel
the user moves Shell to the expanded panel using its context menu
the user selects Tools and then returns to 3D Model
Shell is absent from the Modify main panel
the user opens the Modify expanded panel
Shell is available in the expanded panel
the user moves Shell back to the main panel using its context menu
Shell appears in the main Modify panel
